meta.scope: Bolivia national core — converted/merged from Grok's 6 pre-spec raw batches (2026-08-13), applying the current v2 data spec. 60 raw candidates reduced to 37 kept reports (23 dropped: 4 institution nodes, 12 framing nodes, 4 real-but-unstable/unverifiable topics deferred, 1 classification-not-a-publication, plus small containment cleanups). 51 raw proposed edges reduced to 21 kept dependencies (many converted from invalid legacy relationship types produced_by/part_of/related_to/complements into either valid dependency types with corrected direction, part_of fields on the Report, or dropped as not real data-lineage dependencies). 3 headline claims spot-verified: national-accounts base-year change to 2017/SCN2008 confirmed accurate; Bolivia's MERCOSUR membership claim found overstated (still mid-ratification, corrected by deferring the node); the two China/Russia lithium contracts confirmed real but currently suspended by a Bolivian court ruling with no public contract text, so deferred rather than minted.

reports.title: Encuesta de Hogares (EH) / Household Survey
reports.description: Annual household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with urban/rural and departmental domains.

reports.title: Pobreza monetaria / Monetary poverty
reports.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from EH) with nationally defined poverty lines. Published with urban/rural and departmental breakdowns.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Líneas de pobreza y pobreza extrema
reports.description: Monetary values of the moderate and extreme poverty lines (per capita), differentiated for urban and rural areas and updated with price information.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.

reports.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Bolivia
reports.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Major base-year revision completed in 2025 (new reference year 2017, SCN 2008).

reports.title: Programa Monetario del BCB
reports.description: Annual monetary programme and periodic execution reports setting targets for monetary emission, net domestic credit and net international reserves.

reports.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys; underpins the revised population projections (EPP Rev. 2025).

reports.title: Índice de Gini / Income inequality
reports.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality calculated from EH income data. Companion indicator to the monetary-poverty series.
reports._domains_note: Domain semantic pass 2026-08-18 — same mapping applied to the staged Grok archive, for consistency.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and changes in reserve assets.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
reports.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods. Export basket dominated by minerals (gold, silver, zinc, tin), hydrocarbons (gas), and non-traditional agro-products (soy derivatives, beef, Brazil nuts).
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Gas natural — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of natural-gas production and exports. Historically the dominant export and fiscal-revenue source; now in structural decline.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Minerales — oro, plata, zinc, estaño
reports.description: Statistics of mineral production and exports (gold, silver, zinc, tin and others). Now the leading merchandise-export category by value.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Soya y derivados — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of soybean and soybean-product production and exports. Leading non-traditional agro-export, concentrated in the eastern lowlands (Santa Cruz).

reports.title: Impuesto Directo a los Hidrocarburos (IDH)
reports.publisher: Servicio de Impuestos Nacionales (SIN) / Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas Públicas
reports.description: Direct tax on hydrocarbons. Historically the central fiscal instrument that channelled gas rents into national and subnational budgets and social programmes.

reports.title: Renta Dignidad — universal old-age pension
reports.publisher: Gestora Pública de la Seguridad Social de Largo Plazo
reports.description: Non-contributory universal pension for older adults. Flagship social-protection programme financed in part from hydrocarbon rents.

reports.title: Bono Juancito Pinto — school attendance cash transfer
reports.description: Conditional cash transfer paid to schoolchildren (and families) to encourage enrolment, attendance and completion. Covers primary and secondary levels.

reports.title: Bono Juana Azurduy — maternal and early-childhood transfer
reports.description: Conditional cash transfer for pregnant women and children under two, aimed at improving maternal and child health outcomes.

reports.title: Sistema educativo — cobertura y gasto
reports.description: Education-system statistics (enrolment, attendance, institutional counts) and public education expenditure. Complements the Juancito Pinto transfer.

reports.title: Sistema de salud — cobertura y gasto
reports.description: Public health-system statistics and health expenditure. Complements the Juana Azurduy transfer and the broader social-protection architecture.

reports.title: Presupuesto General del Estado / National Budget
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas Públicas
reports.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the public sector.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Recaudación tributaria y aduanera
reports.publisher: Servicio de Impuestos Nacionales (SIN) / Aduana Nacional
reports.description: Tax and customs collection statistics. Primary non-hydrocarbon revenue-side fiscal product.

reports.title: Deuda pública / Public debt statistics
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas Públicas
reports.description: Stock and flow statistics of public debt (external and domestic). Key sustainability indicator under fiscal pressure.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Informalidad laboral / Labour informality
reports.description: Share of employed persons in informal employment. Structural feature of the Bolivian labour market and a primary determinant of household income security.

reports.title: Remesas familiares / Family remittances
reports.description: Inflows of personal transfers from Bolivians living abroad. Major secondary-income item in the balance of payments and a direct support to household consumption.
reports._domains_note: Domain semantic pass 2026-08-18 — same mapping applied to the staged Grok archive, for consistency.

reports.title: Necesidades Básicas Insatisfechas (NBI) / Unsatisfied Basic Needs
reports.description: Structural (non-monetary) poverty measure based on deprivations in housing, services, education and health. Complementary to the income-poverty series.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Inseguridad alimentaria / Food insecurity (ELCSA scale)
reports.description: Experience-based food-insecurity indicators from the household survey using the Latin American and Caribbean Food Security Scale.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Inversión Extranjera Directa / FDI statistics
reports.description: Statistics of foreign direct investment flows and stocks by sector. Part of the external accounts and specialised BCB analysis.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Industria manufacturera — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Manufacturing production and export statistics. Includes soy derivatives, processed foods, textiles, wood products and other non-traditional manufactures.
reports._domains_note: Domain semantic pass 2026-08-18 — same mapping applied to the staged Grok archive, for consistency.

reports.title: Empleo formal / Formal employment
reports.description: Share and absolute number of employed persons in formal jobs (with social-security coverage or registered contracts). Complement to the informality series.

reports.title: Condiciones de vivienda y servicios básicos
reports.description: Housing quality, overcrowding, and access to water, sanitation and electricity. Core components of the NBI measure and of everyday living standards.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

reports.title: Mortalidad infantil y neonatal
reports.description: Infant and neonatal mortality rates. Long-run health-outcome indicator complementary to the maternal-transfer and health-system nodes.

reports.title: Autoidentificación indígena originaria campesina (Censo)
reports.description: Census and survey statistics of population self-identification with Indigenous nations, peoples, or Afro-Bolivian identity. Core plurinational demographic indicator.

reports.title: Naciones Quechua y Aymara — demographic weight
reports.description: The two largest Indigenous nations by self-identification. Together they account for the large majority of the Indigenous population.

reports.title: Tasa de alfabetismo / Literacy rate
reports.description: Literacy rate for the adult population, published nationally and by Indigenous self-identification, area and department.

reports.title: Idiomas hablados / Language statistics
reports.description: Statistics of languages spoken (Spanish, Quechua, Aymara and others), from census and household surveys. Core plurinational cultural indicator.

reports.title: Población de 65 años y más / Population ageing
reports.description: Share and absolute size of the population aged 65 and over. Demographic context for the Renta Dignidad and health-system pressure.

reports.title: Incidencia de pobreza, según departamento (INE)
reports.description: Official departmental tabulations of monetary poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.
reports._domains_note: proposed: prefix dropped 2026-08-18 — the tag was promoted into Domain in the same pass.

dependencies.basis: BCB's own methodology document states verbatim that Bolivia's balance of payments is compiled “siguiendo las directrices de la QUINTA edición del Manual de Balanza de Pagos (MBP5)” — i.e. BPM5, not BPM6, and no imf-bpm5 node exists in this corpus. Thomas's explicit call (2026-08-26, HANDOFF item 6): wire this to imf-bpm6 anyway, on the assumption BCB's practice has since moved on even though the only located primary source still names BPM5 by number. Recorded here as a directed assumption overriding the literal source text, not a raw-verified BPM6 citation — see andean-wiring-grok-2026-08.json's _dropped array (reason: wrong-target) for the exact quote this overrides, should anyone want to re-check BCB's current practice.

Verified via web search: Bolivia's MERCOSUR status is NOT settled full membership as the original candidate claimed — accession ratification was still working through member states' legislatures as of the most recent reporting found (Brazil's Senate approval, Bolivia's own Senate passing the accession bill in mid-2024, but full completion unclear). CAN membership is real and longstanding, MERCOSUR claim was overstated. Worth a precise future round once ratification status is unambiguous, citing the actual accession protocol.

The underlying Bolivia-Brazil gas relationship is real (long-standing pipeline/GSA), but the candidate was a narrative description rather than a citation to the actual 1996 Gas Supply Agreement document — didn't have time this round to track down the specific instrument text. Good candidate for a future pass.

Verified via web search: this contract is real (YLB-CBC, Chinese consortium) but currently suspended by a Bolivian court ruling, and reporting describes the contract text as not fully public ('secret vote' controversy per Argus Media). Not a stable, citable, publicly-documented instrument as of this research round — revisit once the legal status resolves and/or contract text becomes public.
Same situation as the CBC contract — verified as real (YLB-Uranium One/Russian partner) but suspended by the same court ruling, contract text not public. Deferred for the same reason.

'complements' isn't a valid relationship_type, and on reflection these describe policy-goal alignment, not a data-lineage dependency (the cash transfer's own data doesn't derive from education/health enrollment stats or vice versa). Not reworked into a valid type because there isn't a real data dependency here to state precisely.

'related_to' isn't a valid relationship_type. These are real correlations (informality associates with poverty) but not data-lineage dependencies — one series isn't calculated from or citing the other, they're independently derived from the same source survey (bo-eh), which is captured by direct uses_data_from edges to bo-eh instead.

Literacy rate is measured via the census/household survey, not derived from the education-sector coverage report — the original basis text was an analytical claim ('literacy is an outcome indicator of the education system') rather than a real data-source dependency.
'complements' isn't a valid relationship_type. Both are separate census questions/tables (now both part_of bo-censo) rather than one depending on the other's data.

Converted to the part_of field on bo-ied instead of a dependency edge, per spec rule 5 — FDI flows are reported within the BOP financial account.
Redundant with the part_of field now set on this node pointing at bo-censo — a dependency edge between a node and its own container is invalid per spec rule 5.
